dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: If only we could find a way to increase the cabin capacity...

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Wouldn't that affect the ship's hull though?

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: At least, simply changing the material wouldn't cut it.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But based on my calculations, if this cabin here could be opened up to the one next door...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But you said that wouldn't work, so maybe it really isn't possible...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, does everyone in Liyue know as much about ships as you do, Qishan?

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: After all, we have people working in all sorts of industries in Liyue.
